note: A2.5. Baseline 2026-09-16 = 0.00 on every row: the producer emits queue_producer:welcome@example.com (a PAYLOAD minted into a topic) and the worker, finding no literal at all, collapses to the framework tag queue_consumer:unresolved:celery -- so the two sides of the SAME task never pair. For a task queue the join key is the TASK: the receiver of `.delay(` on the producer side, the decorated `def` on the consumer side. Graded on the task qname, never on a raw QUEUE_FLOWS count.
